overlap.note: ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT is drawn ENTIRELY from the TRAIN split and is disjoint from VAL808. Overlap is computed on exact sample_id equality, not on filename heuristics.

B_phi.dev_relation: IN_SAMPLE — the final refit sees all 4957 DEV rows

S_omega.dev_relation: IN_SAMPLE — the final refit sees all 4957 DEV rows

independence_classification.ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT: IN_SAMPLE_DEVELOPMENT — training population for B_phi and S_omega, and a subset of the TRAIN split used by G and R_psi. Selection-contaminated by construction.
independence_classification.VAL808: OUT_OF_SAMPLE_BUT_CONSUMED_DEVELOPMENT_BENCHMARK — disjoint from TRAIN, so out-of-sample for all four components; but already consumed by Phase27 (preservation) and Phase29 (three-seed), so not pristine.
independence_classification.reason: ROUTER_HOLDOUT (875) was consumed by Phase30 and is OPENED_AND_FROZEN; TEST is locked until Phase39. No untouched independent population remains.

patient_and_source_clustering.note: patient_id is 'NOT_AVAILABLE' for ISIC, BUSI and KVASIR; only KUB carries real patient identifiers (267). case_id is 'NOT_AVAILABLE' in every domain. Patient-level clustering is therefore only possible inside KUB.

population_roles_declared.primary: ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT n=4957 — preserves the frozen Phase-28 contract held_constant population
population_roles_declared.secondary: VAL808 n=808 — SEPARATE prospective descriptive proposal; requires its own approval and must not be pooled with the primary
population_roles_declared.note: The frozen Phase-28 contract fixes population = ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT. VAL808 is outside that contract and is therefore not automatically authorised.
